author: Vibo
description: Artist photos and album covers from TheAudioDB, Deezer, iTunes and MusicBrainz. Order or switch off each source in Settings → Providers.

assistant.instructions: Artist photos and album covers from four sources: TheAudioDB (artists, exact name match), Deezer (artists + albums), iTunes (albums only — iTunes has no artist photos) and MusicBrainz / Cover Art Archive (artists + albums; slow by design — rate limiting adds ~1-2s per lookup, best for obscure releases). Fetch one image via POST /v1/images/{artist|album} with pluginId=artwork/<source> (audiodb, deezer, itunes or musicbrainz; the bare source name also works) — it returns the url inline. search_art (Deezer) and search_album_art (iTunes) return MULTIPLE candidates with names, so a model can pick the right one (reissues, common names) and hand the url to whatever needs it.

tools.name: search_art
tools.description: Search Deezer for artist portraits or album covers — returns up to `limit` candidates (name + image url) instead of one auto-pick

tools.name: search_album_art
tools.description: Search iTunes for album covers — returns up to `limit` candidates (album + artist + 600x600 url) instead of one auto-pick
